openQuestions: For each component/CAD ID, what failure mode, inspection trigger, alert, repair reference and history/retest entry belong in the pit plan?
Are accelerometer mounting, range/bandwidth, sampling/filtering and RPM suitable for a repeatable known-condition baseline? No validated diagnostic thresholds yet.
How will a real chassis bay preserve frame and bumper load paths?
What measured ranges of game-piece dimensions, stiffness, friction and compression occur in new and worn samples? Record uncertainty; tolerances are TBD.
Which roller gaps, guides or settings should be adjustable, lockable and repeatable, and how will wear tests expose jams, slip, piece damage and release variation?
Which attributed component, material or tolerance lessons from prior-team CAD inform an original design without replicating team geometry?

programming.pseudocode: PLANNING ONLY, not robot control. Consider parallel DRIVE toward reload and AIM using measured pose. RELEASE only if retention, moving-shot accuracy, envelope, power and shared-resource guards are established; otherwise defer release or choose stop-and-shoot. A reversible intake/shooter must own its actuator exclusively and cannot intake and eject simultaneously. Compare separate paths or purposeful redundancy rather than assume one architecture. The current rehearsal budget is serialized and demonstrates no concurrency savings. OBSERVE commanded versus measured RPM and freshness; disclose fault and requested/active mode. IF persistent underperformance AND operator requests a validated degraded profile THEN consider bounded shorter-range matched-wheel operation, not a proven shot. Release remains inhibited unless sensor, range, thermal/current and resource guards pass. Use tested enter/exit thresholds, dwell and hysteresis; cancel explicitly and acknowledge recovery. Thresholds and fault-injection evidence are TBD; no safety or accuracy claim.

states.failure: Remain idle if required inputs are missing

states.action: Display fault reason, requested/active mode and release inhibit; explore matched-wheel shorter-range profile only within validated limits
states.entry: Operator requests a tested degraded profile; otherwise remain nominal or inhibit release
states.failure: Inhibit release for stale or implausible sensors, limit exceedance, unknown shot envelope or resource conflicts; explicit cancel and recovery acknowledgment with hysteresis; fault-injection tests pending
states.sensor: Commanded/measured RPM and freshness; range, current/thermal limits; enter/exit thresholds and dwell times TBD from tests
